_why_two_claims: AGREEMENT asks whether the engines compute the same thing; RECOVERY asks whether they compute the right thing. Neither implies the other.

truth.source: the fixture's data-generating process: binormal, equal variance, shift 1.2; AUC = Phi(1.2 / sqrt 2)

agreement.claim: both engines report the same AUC, DeLong SE and interval, Youden threshold, sensitivity and specificity
agreement._note: Observed spread on the committed fixture: 0. harness/diagnostic_examples.test.py checks the AUC equals scipy's Mann-Whitney U / (m n) and the reversed direction gives 1 - AUC, and shows the data-chosen Youden index is optimistic on average.

recovery.claim: the estimates are close to the fixture's

calibration.rule: about 1.3 times the measured 99th percentile miss, rounded up
calibration.limits: The tolerance separates the AUC from 0.5 by a wide margin. Measured by harness/diagnostic_examples.test.py over seeds 0 to 99 (MALLARD_SEEDS=100); CI reruns it on seeds 0 to 49 at the same order statistic.
